'''Gu'Tanoth''' is an [[ogre]] city far south of [[Ardougne]] and slightly south-west of [[Yanille]]. Players need to progress far enough into the [[Watchtower]] quest in order to enter.

Some ogres here are [[aggressive]] to players.

==Features==
===Marketplace===
*A [[general store]]: sells a generic stock of common general store items.
*A [[herblore shop]]: sells [[vial]]s for 2 coins each, a [[pestle and mortar]] for 5 coins each and [[eye of newt|eyes of newt]] for 3 coins each.
*[[Rock cake]] shop: Rock cakes cannot be purchased from here, but can be stolen with level 15 [[Thieving]]. They inflict damage if eaten, and are used for the [[Watchtower Quest]].

===Raised area===
You may access the raised area via the north east corner displayed on the map; take the western gate. Up here, there are some rowdy [[ogre]]s, a [[bone]] respawn, and some [[ogre chieftain]]s. There are two chests located in the raised area. One [[Chest (Gu'Tanoth)|chest]] is located in the southern part of the city, near the Ogre chieftain. The second [[Chest (Gu'Tanoth, spider)|chest]] is located in the central part of the city.

===Ogre Enclave===
{{main|Ogre Enclave}}
This cave contains many high level monsters. In the centre of the cave is the [[Rock of Dalgroth]], which players must mine during the [[Watchtower]] quest. The [[ogre shaman]]s in there are invincible and can only be killed during the quest.

===Skavid Caves===
{{main|Skavid caves}}
The [[Skavid]]s are a cave-dwelling race and slaves of [[ogre]]s. To enter their caves, players must have a [[Skavid map]], which is obtained during the [[Watchtower]] quest, and a [[light source]]. 

===Gu'Tanoth Island===
[[File:GuTanoth Island hard clue route.png|thumb|Travel route to ladder on Gu'Tanoth Island. Run from fairy ring AKS to the cave south west of Gu'Tanoth. This brings you directly to the ladder on the island. Bring a spade and be prepared to fight a Saradomin wizard.]]
An island can be found to the east of the city. The ''only'' way to get onto the island is by taking a specific cave entrance (the broken bridge leading to a small island is ''not'' passable). The relevant cave can be found in the Skavid Caves, south-west of Gu'Tanoth. It lies between four rocks to the west and some ruins to the south-east. Note that you do ''not'' need a skavid map to enter this cave.  On the island is [[Gorad]], which players must talk to during the [[Watchtower]] quest. 

[[File:Coordinate clue 04.05S 04.24E.png|thumb|Clue Scroll dig location.]]
The island is also a location for a [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Coordinates|coordinate clue]] for clue scrolls. Dig on the east side of the island, near a spear wall.
